Use case: illustration-story. Create the next wordless comic panel after the attached reference, in exactly the same polished, soft, rounded glossy 3D children's fantasy animation style. The SAME FIVE friends have landed and are now STANDING at the princess castle's magnificent CLOSED golden double doors. Full-body five-person group, all feet touching the pearly courtyard, no flying, no rocket exhaust. No additional characters.
Character continuity, one of each: Odette brown hair lavender clip and bright BLUE eyes; Aurora pink hair purple eyes small gold forehead star with white scrollwork; Eclipse lavender hair and skin purple eyes central lavender curl. All three retain reference's yellow spacesuits with white bellies and pink bow gems, gloves and boots, yellow cat-ear bubble helmets with yellow bows, pink/mint ear interiors, white side caps with pink hearts, clear closed visors. Pink-white-yellow twin rockets STRAPPED ON THEIR BACKS, behind shoulders, switched off. No wings, crowns or dresses. Exclude Dingdong. Fourth friend Kirby, simple round pink body stubby arms deep red feet tall blue-black oval eyes blush cheeks. Fifth turquoise friend, small turquoise body with huge sweeping turquoise ears lined coral orange, long flowing turquoise tail, sparkling blue oval eyes and rosy cheeks. The two new friends keep their designs without clothing.
Scene: camera a little to the side of the entrance, at the friends' height, allowing three-quarter faces to show as they turn toward the majestic doors and look up in happy anticipation. Odette nearest the door with one small hand raised toward its star-shaped knocker; Aurora and Eclipse just behind, the pink and turquoise friends beside them. Arrange in a relaxed close group, five distinct fully visible silhouettes, no duplications, no poster line-up facing the viewer. Wide 16:9 composition. Large arched golden double doors with central raised star medallion dominate centre-right background; frame with pastel pink/lavender/mint castle stone, gold trims, softly rounded columns, blue and purple crystal ornaments. Match the castle in the reference. Pearlescent terrace and end of rainbow path below their feet, low fluffy clouds at outer edge, a small glimpse of purple-blue starry space and tiny distant golden Pop Star off to left. Castle doors stay CLOSED; no host or inside reveal yet. Beautiful soft warm welcome lighting and subtle sparkle, magical gentle atmosphere. No text, lettering, captions, labels, speech bubbles, watermark or borders.
